project: DSC5001 · Team Machine Not Learning · Module 04

simulation.shortage_rule: lost sales (unmet demand is not backfilled)
simulation.lead_time_delivery: order placed at the start of the period, delivered immediately within the period
simulation.order_rule: S = chosen quantile of that period's 28-day cumulative demand; order = max(0, S - opening on-hand inventory)
simulation.stockout_cost_timing: unmet quantity within the period × Cu
simulation.fill_rate_definition: quantity filled within the period / actual demand quantity (period-level aggregate)
simulation.evaluation_mode: 4 consecutive periods simulated (validation_1..3 + test, back to back)
simulation.known_approximation: period-level aggregate; the intra-period timing of stockouts is not modelled

single_point_to_cycle_quantile.method: error addition: the tau quantile of the 28-day cumulative error from an earlier window (the three baselines have no distribution layer and are constructed by this module)
single_point_to_cycle_quantile.formula: q_tau_i = max(S_hat_i + Q_tau_m, 0), where Q_tau_m is the tau quantile of (actual demand - cumulative point forecast) over earlier windows, pooled per model; truncated at >=0 and forced monotone in tau
single_point_to_cycle_quantile.x_definition: e = sum28 y_true - sum28 y_hat, taking the cumulative error over all completed windows before origin_d for each (series, model), pooled per model into an empirical quantile
single_point_to_cycle_quantile.note: lightgbm reads M2's period.parquet directly (23 points read as-is, no grid trimming) and is not converted; the three baselines are constructed by M4, so the burden of proof lies with this module. Conventions tested and discarded: per-series daily residual resampling 0.76–0.80, pooled standardised z 0.77, per-series training-period block difference 0.62, z quantile × σ restoration 0.96–0.98 (mean S reaching 2.9 times demand); the final choice adds error quantiles directly, giving realised coverage of 0.918–0.950 at τ=0.95 across 4 windows (four models, per window — see coverage_report.csv).

coverage_check.known_limitation: The 28-day cumulative quantiles at low τ (0.80–0.88) are too narrow, with realised coverage as low as 0.4234, below nominal; of all 368 rows, 39 deviate by more than 0.05, 39 of them at τ≤0.88 and 34 in the first window 1829. The maximum deviation at headline τ=0.95 is 0.0318 < 0.05, so the main cost conclusions hold; but cost conclusions at τ<0.90 are unusable, and the report reports τ≥0.90 only.

quality_controls.quantile_conversion_note: number of (series, origin) groups with missing σ; for these groups the baseline quantile degrades to the point forecast
